speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are an 8-year-old having trouble sleeping and waking up frightened; can you tell me exactly what happens during these episodes? Have you noticed any unusual movements, sounds, or feelings before these events start?

speaker: Patient
text: 8-year-old female. The patient has been experiencing difficulty sleeping for the past 2 months, with episodes of waking up frightened occurring one to two times per week. During these episodes, she yells and cries but does not seem confused after waking and can be consoled by her parents. The following day, she appears more tired than usual.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Sleep Terrors (Night Terrors)

Based on your description of yelling and crying without confusion or memory of the event, this fits the pattern of sleep terrors. Do you notice if these episodes happen in the first half of the night, and does she have a history of bedwetting or stress?
